Hi Thomas —

Thanks for the quick submission and for attaching the signed form. A few quick notes on Redwood’s vendor-change process so expectations are clear:

- Finance requires the signed vendor change form + a bank verification document (voided check or bank letter) + a completed ACH authorization when applicable.
- We run a short KYC/verification and usually hold payment for up to 3 business days while verification completes; in some cases we place a one-payment test before moving future POs to the new account.
- For PO impact: if the cut-off for payment processing is reached before our verification completes, the payment will go to the legacy account for that single run — we’ll re-route subsequent payments.

I’ve CC’d Marissa in Finance and Karthik from Vendor Ops to start the internal checklist. Can you confirm (A) whether the change is due to a bank merger (helps our audit trail) and (B) the effective date HarborTech wishes to cutover for receivables?

—Lauren
